# Height 6: BOTH, NEITHER, BOTH, NEITHER, BOTH

import json

output = [[1 for _ in range(17)] for _ in range(14)]

# = BLUE1 = height 4, rows 0-3

output[0][10] = output[0][11] = output[0][12] = output[0][13] = 6

output[2][9] = output[2][14] = 6   # NEITHER: [10,14] -> [9,14]
output[3][10] = output[3][11] = output[3][12] = output[3][13] = 6

# = BLUE2 = height 6, rows 4-9
# Side rows: BOTH, NEITHER, BOTH, NEITHER, BOTH

output[9][7] = output[9][8] = output[9][9] = output[9][10] = 6  # bottom
